On stage

🏆 Distinction Award April 2026 · Singapore

ASEAN Geospatial Challenge 2026

Represented Universitas Gadjah Mada at the ASEAN level, organised by the Singapore Land Authority, with GeoSpectra: AI-based 3D modelling for rooftop photovoltaic potential and property tax valuation.

The project first won the Indonesian national round, hosted by the Geospatial Information Agency (BIG), in December 2025.
